name: Morison
source: CRON 2026-11-21: Morison Industries Plc unaudited statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income for the period ended 30 September 2026 (NGX doclib filing library, JAN-SEP 2026 column), printed in thousands of naira, read by OCR at 200dpi because the filing carries no text layer, and scaled to naira. Revenue less Cost of Sales equals the printed gross profit of 162,332 thousand. Operating Expenses is the printed distribution expenses of 65,055 thousand plus operating expenses of 129,665 thousand less the printed other operating income of 67,080 thousand, so that gross profit less operating expenses equals the printed profit from operations of 34,692 thousand. Net Finance Costs is the printed net finance expenses of 11,680 thousand (finance expenses 14,675 thousand less finance income 2,995 thousand), and profit from operations less net finance costs equals the printed profit before taxation of 23,012 thousand. No tax was charged, so profit for the period is the same 23,012 thousand. EPS is left blank because the printed loss per share of 0.02 kobo does not reconcile to a profit of 23,012 thousand on the share capital shown. | Morison Industries Plc unaudited statement of profit or loss for the period ended 30 June 2026 (NGX doclib filing library), Jan-Jun 2026 column, thousands scaled to naira. Tax expense is printed as nil. EPS as printed, confirmed against 1,000,000,000 ordinary shares. | NGX (doclib.ngxgroup.com) | CRON 20260929_003746: Income Tax sign normalised to the dataset convention, the charge stored positive and a credit negative, on 1 period(s), so that the rendered Profit Before Tax less Income Tax equals Net Profit. The required sign is fixed by the direction of the move from Profit Before Tax to Net Profit in the stored rows, and the stored magnitude already agreed with that move. CRON 20261002: Net Profit and Income Tax rows corrected to the audited five-year summary p.35. PBT less tax equals PAT on all five years. | CRON 2026-11-28: 9M 2026 EPS 0.02 read from the Q3 2026 filing statement of profit or loss, JAN-SEP 2026 column. The line is headed Loss per share (kobo) but the four printed values 0.03 / 0.02 / 0.02 / 0.02 are naira, because 9M profit of 23,012,000 over 1,256,000,000 shares is 0.0183 naira and Q3 profit of 33,701,000 over the same count is 0.0268 naira, which round to the printed 0.02 and 0.03. Read as kobo the figures would be a hundred times too small. The earlier note on this file had treated the printed figure as a loss in kobo; the OCR text also confirms the P&L columns (JUL-SEP 2026, JUL-SEP 2025, JAN-SEP 2026, JAN-SEP 2025), with Jan-Sep revenue 448,417 thousand, gross profit 162,332 thousand and profit before tax 23,012 thousand matching the stored rows.

rows.label: Cost of Sales
rows.sign_normalized: negated to the dataset convention: stored negative, which broke the printed identity Revenue - Cost of Sales = Gross Profit, and the column ties with it positive

reconciliation_note: Gross Profit - Operating Expenses = Operating Profit (EBIT) does not hold in FY2025, FY2024: the filed operating profit is a subtotal that also carries operating income not shown as a separate row in this file, and it ties forward to Profit Before Tax. The figure is corroborated by the statement's own bridge and is shown unchanged.
